description.en: Weijian Shi at Fudan University. Research interests in embodied intelligence, robot learning, and mixture-of-experts models.
description.zh: Weijian Shi，复旦大学。关注具身智能、机器人学习与混合专家模型。

intro.en: I’m interested in how intelligent systems learn to act in the physical world.
intro.zh: 我关注智能系统如何学习，并在真实的物理世界中行动。

bio.en: My interests span embodied intelligence, robot learning, and mixture-of-experts models. I explore how internal model dynamics relate to robot behavior, with a focus on reliability and learning efficiency.
bio.zh: 我的研究兴趣包括具身智能、机器人学习与混合专家模型。我关注模型内部动态与机器人行为之间的联系，并探索如何提升执行可靠性与学习效率。

description.en: Learning policies for perception, decision-making, and action in the physical world.
description.zh: 探索物理世界中的感知、决策与行动，以及支撑这些能力的学习策略。

description.en: Routing dynamics, expert interactions, and the behavior of sparsely activated models.
description.zh: 理解稀疏模型中的路由动态、专家交互及其与模型行为的联系。

description.en: Data-efficient training, failure recovery, and execution quality beyond task success.
description.zh: 研究高效的数据利用、失败恢复，以及任务成功之外的执行质量。

image_alt.en: Conceptual illustration of routing pathways in a robot policy
image_alt.zh: 机器人策略中路由路径的概念示意图

title.zh: 面向机器人学习的内在信号

description.en: Exploring the internal routing dynamics of mixture-of-experts policies for execution monitoring, recovery, and more efficient robot learning.
description.zh: 探索混合专家策略的内部路由动态，研究其在执行监测、失败恢复与高效机器人学习中的作用。

questions.en: Execution monitoring from the first policy inference.
questions.zh: 从第一次策略推理开始进行执行监测。

questions.en: Recovery evaluated through task outcomes, including both benefits and harms.
questions.zh: 通过任务结果评估恢复操作，同时考察收益与损害。

questions.en: Using model structure to guide more efficient training and data use.
questions.zh: 利用模型结构探索更高效的训练与数据利用方式。

questions.en: Improving the smoothness and directness of successful executions.
questions.zh: 提升成功执行过程的流畅性，减少不必要的动作。

contact.en: Interested in robot learning, embodied intelligence, or the inner workings of models? Let’s connect.
contact.zh: 如果你也关注机器人学习、具身智能，或模型内部的工作机制，欢迎交流。
